name: Wh-question
definition: Question opening with what/where/when/why/how/who/which/whom/whose.

name: Yes-no question
definition: Question opening with an auxiliary verb (is/are/do/can/would...), expecting yes or no.

name: Rhetorical question
definition: Question not seeking an answer; often a declarative with a tag ("..., right?" / "isn't it?").

name: Open-ended question
definition: Invites an extended answer ("what do you think/propose/suggest?").

name: Seek explanation
definition: Asks for reasoning or elaboration ("why is...", "please explain/elaborate/clarify").

name: Statement
definition: Plain declarative assertion; default act for a declarative sentence.

name: Informative statement
definition: Statement carrying new factual content — numbers, percentages, dollar/year figures.

name: Action directive / command
definition: Imperative telling the listener to do something.

name: Offer
definition: Offers to do or provide something ("would you like...", "let me help", "I can offer").

name: Acknowledgment
definition: Backchannel signalling receipt ("I see", "right", "okay", "mm-hmm", "got it").

name: Agreement
definition: Explicit agreement ("I agree", "exactly", "you're right", "that's a good point").

name: Disagreement
definition: Explicit disagreement ("I disagree", "that's not right", "I beg to differ").

name: Rejection
definition: Flat rejection ("no", "absolutely not", "that's false", "never").

name: Answer
definition: Direct answer, typically opening with yes/no.

name: Greeting
definition: Greeting or welcome ("good evening", "welcome", "thank you for joining").

name: Apology
definition: Apology ("I'm sorry", "my apologies", "I regret").

name: Thanks
definition: Expression of thanks ("thank you", "thanks").

name: Explanation
definition: Gives reasoning or restatement ("because", "the reason is", "in other words").

name: Correction / self-clarification
definition: Corrects or clarifies own prior statement ("let me clarify", "to be clear", "I misspoke").

name: Challenge / fact-check
definition: Challenges accuracy of a claim ("that's incorrect/misleading/a distortion/false").

name: Take/hold turn
definition: Bids to take or hold the floor ("let me say", "if I may", "may I", "excuse me").

name: Turn-give
definition: Hands the floor to another ("what do you think?", "your turn", "over to you").

name: Turn request
definition: Requests permission to speak ("am I allowed", "can I respond/finish").

name: Repeat request
definition: Asks for repetition ("can you repeat", "could you say that again").

name: Maintain / steer topic
definition: Steers back to or holds a topic ("but let me ask", "as I was saying", "I'll come back to").

name: Historical / self reference
definition: References a year, historical figure, or event (Reagan, civil war, founding fathers, "in 1994").

name: Interrupt
definition: Cuts off another speaker. Needs timing/floor context — model leaves this 0; human judgement required.

name: Turn-accept
definition: Accepts an offered turn. Context-dependent — model leaves this 0; human judgement required.

name: Appeal to fear
definition: Uses fear/threat language (disaster, catastrophe, crisis, danger, invasion, collapse).

name: Appeal to emotion
definition: Emotional appeal ("if you care", "imagine if", "the children", "our families").

name: Appeal to pride
definition: Appeals to national/group pride ("great country", "American values", "proud to be").

name: Appeal to patriotism
definition: Patriotic framing (america, freedom, liberty, constitution, flag, "God bless America").

name: Unity framing
definition: Frames as collective unity ("together we", "we as a nation", "common good", "united").

name: Deflection
definition: Redirects away from the question ("the real question is", "what I'm focused on", "let's not forget").

name: Political-outgroup bias
definition: Negative framing of a political outgroup ("Democrats are", "the radical left", "the swamp", "liberal elites").

name: Personal attack
definition: Attacks a person's character (opponent + liar/corrupt/incompetent/crooked/disgrace).

name: Self-promotion / taking credit
definition: Claims personal credit ("I created", "I built", "I delivered", "I cut/reduced").

name: Injecting personal stance
definition: Frames as personal opinion/stance ("I believe", "in my view", "I contend").

name: Biased / loaded question
definition: A question containing loaded terms (liar, corrupt, fraud, criminal, coward).

name: Blame attribution
definition: Assigns blame to a named opponent (opponent + destroyed/ruined/failed us/was responsible for).

name: Adversarial exchange
definition: Personal attack combined with a question or emphatic jab ("again", "just", "simply").

name: Rebuttal
definition: Challenge or disagreement that references the opponent.

name: Race-related content
definition: Mentions race/ethnicity (black/hispanic/asian/white community, racial, ethnic).

name: Gender bias
definition: Bias based on gender. Needs semantic judgement — model leaves this 0; human required.

name: Gender dismissal
definition: Dismissing someone on gendered grounds. Contextual — model leaves this 0; human required.

name: Cognitive bias
definition: A reasoning bias (anchoring, false dilemma, etc.). Needs meaning — model leaves this 0; human required.

name: Issue avoidance
definition: Avoids answering the substantive issue. Needs question/answer pairing — model leaves this 0; human required.

name: Selective evidence
definition: Cherry-picks facts. Needs world knowledge — model leaves this 0; human required.

name: Cultural bias
definition: Bias tied to culture/group. Needs context — model leaves this 0; human required.
